name: browser-use
headline: bilibili subtitle fetcher tool for markdown
short_description: A Claude skill that searches Bilibili (B站) videos by keyword, fetches their subtitles, and converts them into Markdown files. Built for researchers and content analysts working with Chinese video content.
author: suyuan2022

sections.overview:
The bilibili-subtitle-fetcher-skill enables Claude to search Bilibili (B站) by keyword, retrieve subtitles from matching videos, and save them as formatted Markdown files. It processes multiple videos concurrently using up to 3 threads, with built-in request rate control to avoid throttling. Intelligent file naming keeps the output organized, and a standardized Markdown output format makes the subtitles easy to read or feed into downstream workflows. This skill is particularly useful for researchers, content creators, and analysts who need to extract and study text from Chinese video content at scale.
Batch-download subtitles from Bilibili videos matching a research topic
Convert B站 video subtitles to Markdown for note-taking or summarization
Collect transcripts from multiple Bilibili videos concurrently for content analysis
Archive subtitles from Bilibili search results in a structured, readable format
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/suyuan2022/bilibili-subtitle-fetcher-skill`
sections.usage:
```
I need to fetch subtitles from a Bilibili video and convert them to Markdown format. Please search for a video titled '[VIDEO_TITLE]' by '[UPLOADER]' in the '[INDUSTRY]' category. Extract the subtitles and format them as Markdown with timestamps. Ensure the output is clean and ready for documentation purposes.
```
Copy

```
```markdown
# Bilibili Video Subtitles: '[VIDEO_TITLE]' by [UPLOADER]
